title: pos_loyalty — Loyalty Program and Coupon Integration with POS

key_findings.shared_model_with_sale_loyalty: Both pos_loyalty and sale_loyalty inherit from the same loyalty.program in the loyalty base module — single shared table
key_findings.duplicate_card_prevention: _check_existing_loyalty_cards merges onto existing card for same partner+program
key_findings.reward_unlink_guard: archives instead of deletes when pos.order.line references exist
key_findings.company_scope: company_id on base loyalty.program; pos_loyalty enforces currency_id match
key_findings.ilike_rewrite: reward_product_domain ilike conditions rewritten to 'in' with pre-resolved IDs for POS JS

awt_items.description: Verify POS JavaScript/OWL implementation of reward application: how _get_reward_line_values equivalent logic works client-side for discount and product rewards
awt_items.reason: Reward line creation at POS is handled in JavaScript — the Python layer does not have a _get_reward_line_values method in pos_loyalty; the base loyalty module has this in Python but it is not called from POS order flow

awt_items.description: Verify portal balance display: confirm loyalty_card_dialog.xml renders customer point balance in the web portal context and that portal_visible=True correctly gates the display
awt_items.reason: Portal rendering is in JavaScript/XML front-end assets; Python source confirms the field exists and is loaded to POS but portal rendering logic is in static assets
